petition.title: Demanding Fair Treatment for All Asylum Seekers
petition.addressee: To: CGVS / Commissioner General for Refugees and Stateless Persons
petition.p1: We, the undersigned, call upon the Belgian asylum authority (CGVS) to ensure a transparent, humane, and individualized assessment for all applicants. Every story deserves to be heard with the necessary seriousness and dignity.
petition.p2: The current systemic delays and rigid procedural obstacles leave thousands of vulnerable individuals in a legal and emotional limbo. We call for a reform that prioritizes safety and the fundamental right to seek protection without bias.
petition.p3: Our community stands united in the belief that this platform is not just a slogan — it is a requirement for a just society. We request that you review current protocols and reaffirm Belgium's commitment to human rights and international protection standards.

whyTheyLeft.label: Global Context
whyTheyLeft.title: Why they left everything behind
whyTheyLeft.description: Behind every asylum file is a human being who had no choice. Click any country to see the full timeline of what forced them to flee.
whyTheyLeft.gdprNote: All statistics are sourced from UNHCR, OCHA, Human Rights Watch, and Amnesty International. This platform is GDPR compliant. No personal data is collected from this page.
whyTheyLeft.bottomNote: These people are not statistics. They are doctors, teachers, parents, and children who lost everything. When Belgium closes its doors, it sends them back to these realities.

palestine.name: Palestine
palestine.reason: Ongoing genocide, total destruction of infrastructure, no safe zone. Fleeing is not a choice — it is survival.

timeline.title: The Nakba
timeline.description: 700,000 Palestinians forcibly displaced from their homes. The beginning of a displacement that never ended.

timeline.title: Gaza Blockade
timeline.description: Israel imposes a total land, air and sea blockade on Gaza. 2 million people imprisoned in the world's largest open-air prison.

timeline.title: Genocide Begins
timeline.description: The most intense bombing campaign in modern history. Hospitals, schools, and refugee camps targeted. No safe zone exists.

timeline.title: In The Waiting Room
timeline.description: Palestinians who fled to Europe face rejection after rejection. Belgium's CGVS denies their claims despite the documented genocide. They wait — with nowhere to return.

yemen.name: Yemen
yemen.reason: 10 years of war. The world's worst humanitarian crisis. Famine, disease, and daily airstrikes.

timeline.title: Revolution & Collapse
timeline.description: The Arab Spring reaches Yemen. President Saleh ousted after mass protests. Political vacuum creates conditions for conflict.

timeline.title: War Erupts
timeline.description: Saudi-led coalition begins bombing campaign. Within months, Yemen becomes the world's worst humanitarian crisis.

timeline.title: Famine & Cholera
timeline.description: UN declares Yemen the world's worst humanitarian crisis. Largest cholera outbreak in history. Children dying of starvation.

timeline.title: In The Waiting Room
timeline.description: Yemenis who survived bombs and famine now face Belgian bureaucracy. Their asylum files rejected despite documented devastation. The war continues. The waiting room does not end.

syria.name: Syria
syria.reason: 13 years of civil war. Over half the population has been forced to flee their homes.

timeline.title: Peaceful Protests Crushed
timeline.description: Syrian civilians demand reform. Assad's government responds with live ammunition. The seeds of civil war are planted in blood.

timeline.title: Chemical Weapons & ISIS
timeline.description: Sarin gas attacks on civilians. ISIS rises and takes control of vast territories. Syria becomes a battlefield for global powers.

timeline.title: Idlib — The Last Refuge
timeline.description: 3 million civilians trapped in Idlib as the final offensive begins. Hospitals bombed 50+ times. No place left to run inside Syria.

timeline.title: In The Waiting Room
timeline.description: Syrians who fled chemical weapons and barrel bombs now face administrative rejection in Belgium. Many have waited 5–8 years. Their children grew up in uncertainty.

sudan.name: Sudan
sudan.reason: The world's largest displacement crisis in 2024. Civil war, ethnic cleansing, and mass starvation.

timeline.title: Darfur Genocide
timeline.description: Janjaweed militias backed by Khartoum slaughter hundreds of thousands in Darfur. The world watches. Nothing changes.

timeline.title: Revolution & Hope
timeline.description: Sudanese people overthrow Omar al-Bashir after 30 years. Millions celebrate. A brief window of hope opens.

timeline.title: War Returns
timeline.description: SAF and RSF go to war in the streets of Khartoum. Hospitals shelled. Mass rape used as weapon. Ethnic cleansing in Darfur again.

timeline.title: In The Waiting Room
timeline.description: Sudanese who fled ethnic cleansing are told by Belgian authorities their situation is 'not severe enough.' They wait, while their families disappear.

kurdistan.name: Kurdistan
kurdistan.reason: The world's largest stateless nation. Persecuted across Turkey, Syria, Iraq and Iran.

timeline.title: Promised & Betrayed
timeline.description: The Treaty of Sèvres promised Kurds a homeland. The Treaty of Lausanne erased that promise. 40 million people left stateless.

timeline.title: Anfal Genocide
timeline.description: Saddam Hussein's chemical weapons attack on Halabja kills 5,000 Kurds in hours. Over 180,000 killed in the Anfal campaign.

timeline.title: ISIS & Kobane
timeline.description: ISIS surrounds Kobane. Kurdish fighters resist. The world finally watches. But the displacement continues.

timeline.title: In The Waiting Room
timeline.description: Kurdish asylum seekers face a cruel paradox: Belgium questions which country they 'belong to.' The answer is: none. They have no country. Yet their asylum is denied.

afghanistan.name: Afghanistan
afghanistan.reason: Under Taliban rule, women cannot work or study. Minorities face execution. There is no future to stay for.

timeline.title: US Invasion
timeline.description: NATO invades following 9/11. The Taliban falls. Brief hope for a new Afghanistan. 20 years of conflict begin.

timeline.title: Taliban Returns
timeline.description: US withdraws. Taliban takes Kabul in days. Girls banned from school. Women erased from public life. Minorities hunted.

timeline.title: Gender Apartheid
timeline.description: UN declares Taliban's treatment of women 'gender apartheid.' Girls above grade 6 banned from education. Women banned from universities.

timeline.title: In The Waiting Room
timeline.description: Afghan women, journalists, and former NATO translators now wait in Belgium. Rejected. Told to 'return home.' To a home where they would be executed.

eritrea.name: Eritrea
eritrea.reason: Africa's North Korea. Indefinite military conscription. No freedom of press or religion.

timeline.title: Independence & Betrayal
timeline.description: Eritrea gains independence after 30-year war. Hopes for democracy crushed within years. One of Africa's most brutal dictatorships begins.

timeline.title: Darkness Falls
timeline.description: 11 reformers arrested. Independent press shut down overnight. Eritrea becomes a prison state. No elections. No free speech.

timeline.title: Conscription Without End
timeline.description: Military service becomes indefinite. Men and women conscripted for decades. Thousands risk death crossing the Sahara to escape.

timeline.title: In The Waiting Room
timeline.description: Eritreans in Belgium face a system that doubts their persecution. 'Why did you really leave?' they are asked. The answer: to survive. To be free. To exist.

somalia.name: Somalia
somalia.reason: 30+ years of civil war, Al-Shabaab terror, and climate disaster.

timeline.title: State Collapse
timeline.description: President Barre ousted. Somalia enters permanent civil war. For 30+ years, there is no functioning central government.

timeline.title: Al-Shabaab Terror
timeline.description: Al-Shabaab controls large territories. Public executions. Women forced into marriages. Men recruited by force. Fleeing is the only option.

timeline.title: Climate & Conflict
timeline.description: The worst drought in 40 years. Al-Shabaab attacks continue. Triple crisis: conflict, famine, and climate collapse simultaneously.

timeline.title: In The Waiting Room
timeline.description: Somalis in Belgium are told Somalia has 'some safe areas.' Which areas? The ones Al-Shabaab controls? They wait. There is no safe area.

about.heroTitle: A platform born from lived experience
about.heroDescription: The Waiting Room was built by someone who lived through it — years of uncertainty, rejected files, and the invisible weight of legal limbo in Belgium. This platform exists to make that weight visible.
about.founderP1: I arrived in Belgium after years of waiting in Greece. My protection status there meant nothing here. Every door I knocked on led to another waiting room. I built this platform because I refused to wait in silence.
about.founderP2: This is not an organization. There is no funding, no team, no office. Just one person who believes that gathering voices is the first step toward being heard.
about.legalDesc: We document the gap between what the law promises and what migrants actually experience. Every story on this platform is evidence. Every signature is pressure. Together, we build a case that cannot be ignored.
about.inclusionDesc: Every language, every background, every story matters here. No one is left out.
about.united: One community. Many voices. One demand.
